partners.title: Engage independent educators for your programmes
partners.intro: MatchMax helps tutorial centres, day schools, and NGOs find and match self-employed independent educators for course modules, exam clinics, and class series, genuine Contracts for Services, screened before matching.
partners.s1_body: Create an Education Partner account with your registered legal entity name, Business Registration number, and authorised representative. Our team verifies the registration before your account is activated.
partners.s2_body: Describe the course module, exam clinic, or class series and the service fee. Every request passes a four-part screening that confirms it is an independent service engagement, never staff recruitment.
partners.s3_body: When an educator is matched, both sides confirm a one-page Engagement Summary covering scope, rate, and the MatchMax admin fee. Parties execute their own Contract for Services (and NDA, if needed) directly with each other.
partners.rules_title: What MatchMax is, and is not
partners.r1: MatchMax is an independent educator marketplace. It is not an employment agency and does not provide staff or employee recruitment services.
partners.r2: Educators on MatchMax are self-employed professionals. Requests involving administrative, reception, or general staff duties are declined or placed on compliance hold.
partners.r3: Educators keep control of their teaching methodology and stay free to serve other clients.
partners.r4: Vacancy hiring is out of scope, MatchMax never publishes job listings.
partners.fee_body: MatchMax's matching admin fee is owed by the self-employed educator — organisations never pay MatchMax a matching fee. Private / standard matches: 1.5 lessons (100% of Lesson 1 + 50% of Lesson 2). Partner-centre introductions: when the same centre assigns more students to that tutor within 6 months of the original intro, the tutor’s fee steps down — 1st student 1.5 lessons, 2nd 1.0 lesson, 3rd 0.5 lesson, 4th and later $0 (max about 3.0 lessons per centre intro). Short packages of five lessons or fewer use 20% of the package, and pro-bono engagements are free.

paid.q: How does the MatchMax administrative matching fee work?
paid.a: Joining is free. For a standard ongoing case the parent still pays you, the tutor, at your agreed hourly rate for every lesson — including Lessons 1 and 2. What you settle with MatchMax is one administrative matching fee equal to 1.5 lessons of that same tuition: 100% of Lesson 1 plus 50% of Lesson 2, paid once by FPS. It is the slice of those first intros that would otherwise have been your pay — never an extra charge stacked on the parent. For short-term assignments of 5 lessons or fewer, the fee is instead 20% of the total assignment value, so you keep 80%.

anonymity.q: Will my name and photo be publicly visible on Google?
anonymity.a: No. Your public card leads with your preferred display name if you set one, or stays fully anonymous under your MatchMax code (e.g., “MM-T104”). Your legal name, photo, and contact details are never public. The concierge introduces you to parents using your display name, or your last name (e.g., “Tutor Chan”) when that is your preferred form. You control when your full name is shared once lessons begin.

speed.q: How many days does it usually take to find students?
speed.a: Matching speed depends on subject demand, your profile quality, and availability. Many tutors receive relevant student matching requests within 1 to 2 weeks.

rates.a: Usual market rates typically range between HK$300 to HK$600 per hour. However, rates vary depending on lesson mode (online vs. in-person), duration, level, subject complexity, and your academic background. Tutors can discuss and negotiate rates directly with parents to agree on a fair fee.

experience.q: Do I need teaching experience to join?
experience.a: Prior experience helps, but strong academic results, clear communication skills, and a complete profile are equally important for verification and student matching.

modes.q: Can I teach both online and in person?
modes.a: Yes. You can set your preferred lesson modes and target locations in your profile and update them anytime as your schedule changes.

after_trial.q: How do payments work after the trial lessons?
after_trial.a: To give you full financial control and ensure you keep 100% of your earnings, all ongoing lesson fees are paid directly from the parent to you using your preferred method. Because you manage your own ongoing schedule and billing, we recommend collecting payment on a lesson-by-lesson basis or upfront for the month. If a payment issue ever arises, you can report it to our team; while we do not act as a collection agency, we take community safety seriously and will restrict non-paying users from future matching.

fee_types.q: Is the fee the same for a private student and a partner-centre introduction?
fee_types.a: No. Private / standard matches carry 1.5 lessons of tuition per student or case. Partner-centre introductions step down when the same centre assigns more students to you within 6 months of the original intro: 1st student 1.5 lessons, 2nd 1.0, 3rd 0.5, 4th and later 0.

short_package.q: What if the engagement is a short package (5 lessons or fewer)?
short_package.a: Short-term assignments of 5 lessons or fewer are charged at 20% of the total package value instead of the 1.5-lesson fee, so you keep 80%. This applies when a parent explicitly requests a short-term assignment.

contact.q: When do I get the parent’s phone number or WhatsApp?
contact.a: After the Administrative Matching Fee for that match is settled. Until then, the concierge coordinates Lessons 1 and 2 between you and the parent; full phone and WhatsApp details are exchanged once the fee is paid.

employment.a: No. Tutors on MatchMax are independent, self-employed professionals. MatchMax is a marketplace, not an employment agency: we do not hire staff, publish job vacancies, or employ tutors — this is set out in our Terms. You keep control of your rates, teaching methods, and schedule.

negotiate.a: Yes, rates can be negotiated, but any adjustments depend entirely on the tutor's willingness and policy. Factors such as lesson frequency, online vs. in-person mode, travel distance, and lesson length may give room for discussion directly with the tutor.

trial.q: Can I arrange a trial lesson before committing to a regular schedule?
trial.a: Yes. Parents are welcome to request an initial single trial lesson. Whether a trial lesson is offered and its specific terms (paid or discounted) depend entirely on the individual tutor's willingness and policy, which you can confirm directly before starting.

matching.a: You have two straightforward options: you can click forward directly on any tutor's profile card to request that specific tutor, or reach out to our WhatsApp hotline and tell us exactly what you are looking for so we can match you. Once confirmed, we connect you directly with the tutor to finalize lesson times.

anonymity.q: Why does a tutor card show a display name or a code (like “MM-T104”)?
anonymity.a: Tutors can set an optional preferred display name (e.g., “Dr Chan” or “Miss Lee”). If one is set, the card leads with it; if not, the card shows the MatchMax code (e.g., “MM-T104”). The concierge introduces your match by that display name, or in last-name style (e.g., “Tutor Chan”) when that is the tutor’s preferred form. Full names and phone numbers are only exchanged after the introduction, once the fee rules are settled.

involvement.q: How long does MatchMax stay involved in our tutoring arrangement?
involvement.a: MatchMax operates as a high-touch concierge matching service. We actively oversee your onboarding, ensure your trial lesson goes smoothly, and manage the communication for your first 2 lessons until the administrative matching fee is settled. Once this initial matching phase is successfully completed, MatchMax steps back, leaving parents and tutors to manage their ongoing schedule directly.

verification.q: How does MatchMax verify tutor qualifications and grades?
verification.a: MatchMax uses a two-tier system plus a professionals track. Tier 1 tutors list self-reported results as “Stated Qualifications”; you can request photographic proof directly from the tutor before the first lesson. Tier 2 tutors carry the Blue Tick, meaning our team has manually checked their identity and academic documents. Full-time tutors and certified teachers are assessed as Verified Professionals, on degrees, PGDE qualifications, and teaching track records. Verification is a document check only: it does not promise grades or exam outcomes, and it is not an endorsement by IBO, HKEAA, or any school. Either way, you can always ask for proof before committing.

payments.q: How do payments work between parents and tutors?
payments.a: Tuition is paid directly to the tutor based on the agreed hourly rate and schedule. MatchMax does not hold or handle your tuition fees, keeping the payment process direct and transparent.

matching_fee.q: Do I pay MatchMax any matching fee?
matching_fee.a: No. Parents never pay MatchMax a matching fee. You pay the tutor directly at the agreed hourly or package rate for every lesson, including the first two. The administrative matching fee — 1.5 lessons of that same tuition — is owed by the tutor: it is their slice of the first intros, not an extra charge added on top of what you pay.

blue_tick.q: What does the Blue Tick mean?
blue_tick.a: The Blue Tick means our staff have manually checked the tutor’s identity documents and academic transcripts. It is a document check only — it is not a promise of grades or exam outcomes, and it is not an endorsement by IBO, HKEAA, or any school. Tier 1 tutors show self-reported “Stated Qualifications”, and you can ask any tutor for proof before Lesson 1.

pay.q: How and when do I pay for the lessons?
pay.a: For a standard match, the parent pays the tutor directly at the agreed hourly or package rate for every lesson — including Lessons 1 and 2. Parents do not pay MatchMax a matching fee. Instead, the tutor owes one administrative matching fee of 1.5 lessons of that same tuition: 100% of Lesson 1 plus 50% of Lesson 2, paid to MatchMax by FPS. That is the slice of the first two intros that would otherwise have stayed as the tutor’s pay — not an extra charge stacked on the parent. Our concierge stays close for those first lessons and makes sure the match is right. For short-term assignments (5 lessons or fewer) the fee is instead 20% of the total scheduled package. MatchMax does not handle tuition payments.

rematch.q: What if the tutor stops or isn't a good fit?
rematch.a: Message the concierge and we will arrange a rematch or replacement tutor. We support the new introduction and the first lessons; after that, parents and tutors continue directly. A rematch is a matching service — it does not come with a promise of particular grades or exam outcomes. You can leave a review after the first completed lesson.

reschedule.q: What happens if my child is sick or we need to reschedule?
reschedule.a: We understand that schedules change and emergencies happen. We simply ask that parents and tutors communicate directly in your dedicated MatchMax WhatsApp group and aim to provide at least 24 hours' notice out of mutual respect.

account.q: Do I need an account to request a tutor?
account.a: Browsing is free and open, you can look at tutors, guides, and study notes without an account. To submit a request you sign in with Google, one tap, so the concierge knows who to contact and can manage your case.

notes.q: How do purchases of digital study materials work?
notes.a: Study materials are sold through MatchMax only. You pay the full amount to the MatchMax official business account via FPS, and staff release the file inside your account; the tutor receives their 80% net share on the 1st of the following month (MatchMax keeps a 20% platform fee). Direct P2P or WhatsApp payment is for lesson tuition only — never for study materials. Because digital files cannot be returned, all sales are final, so please review the free watermarked preview before purchasing.

centre_ladder.q: How does the partner-centre fee ladder work in practice?
centre_ladder.a: When the same centre assigns you more students within 6 months of the original introduction, your admin fee per extra student steps down: 1st student 1.5 lessons, 2nd 1.0, 3rd 0.5, 4th and later 0. Worked example at an agreed HK$400 hourly rate: the 1st intro costs 1.5 lessons (HK$600), the 2nd 1.0 lesson (HK$400), the 3rd 0.5 lesson (HK$200), and the 4th onward cost nothing. Private cases stay at 1.5 lessons each.

notes_terms.role_title: MatchMax's role and the licence chain
notes_terms.role_body: MatchMax sells a digital file to the buyer. The selling tutor warrants that they own the material, or hold written permission, and licenses the file to MatchMax for sale. The tutor is an independent seller; MatchMax is not the tutor's agent.
notes_terms.warranty_title: The tutor's warranty and the ban list
notes_terms.warranty_body: Every upload warrants that the material is the tutor's own work or carries written permission, and that it is not on the ban list. The ban list is published on the notes guide and includes:
notes_terms.licence_body: A purchase grants a personal licence: one student, no resale, no class set, no uploading elsewhere. Sharing the file beyond the buyer's own use ends the licence.
notes_terms.delivery_body: Files are delivered inside the buyer's account after staff mark the FPS payment as received. The receipt email contains no file. Each file is stamped with the order and account identifiers.
notes_terms.refund_body: Before the payment is confirmed, staff simply reject the payment and you are never charged. After the file is released, the escrow hold applies: a valid dispute (a defective, corrupt, or substantially not-as-described file) is refunded from the still-held funds during the hold window. Once the hold ends and the tutor has been paid, no refund is promised.
notes_terms.takedown_body: We may remove a pack and refund buyers if a rights holder complains. Repeat banned uploads close the tutor's notes privilege; serious breaches suspend selling altogether.
notes_terms.affiliation_body: MatchMax is not affiliated with the IB, HKEAA, or any school. Nothing in these terms promises a grade, an offer, or that a school will accept the notes.
notes_terms.law_body: These terms are governed by the laws of Hong Kong.
notes_terms.escrow_body: MatchMax is the seller of record: parents pay MatchMax by FPS, and the tutor's share is held back after delivery before it joins the monthly payout run. This escrow hold is the buyer's protection.
notes_terms.escrow_hold: After delivery, MatchMax holds the seller's share for 48 hours (72 for new sellers: the first sales or the first 14 days) or until you tap "Received, no issue", whichever comes first.
notes_terms.escrow_refund_source: Refunds are paid ONLY from the still-held seller funds. MatchMax never pays a notes refund out of its own money.
notes_terms.escrow_no_warranty: Notes are study aids written by independent tutors. MatchMax does not warrant that any file is accurate or complete, or that it will produce any grade or exam result.
notes_terms.escrow_remedy: Your remedy is the dispute: if the file is defective or materially different from its description, open a dispute from your order page during the hold window and staff will refund valid cases (full or partial) from the held funds. Once the hold is released there is no refund promise.
